product.name: inference
product.eyebrow: Speech and language AI · Rust libraries
product.lede: Rust libraries for voice and language products whose models you can change: one contract per model kind, pipelines checked before they run, no server or CLI.
product.meta: Rust workspace · libraries only · specified in ESS · Apache-2.0

art.caption: One contract and a mock recogniser, no runtime. Output generated by inference-docs from the example's own function.

sections.title: The model is a part, not the product.

items.title: One contract per model kind
items.description: STT, LLM, TTS, tools and native speech; each works on its own, with a scripted mock for tests.

items.title: Provider by configuration
items.description: talk --provider openai, openai-live or nova runs the same conversation code; the local cascade swaps sherpa-onnx and whisper.cpp with INFERENCE_CASCADE_STT.

items.title: Checked before it runs
items.description: A pipeline is validated and planned first; a node whose model lacks a capability it requires is refused with an error that names both.

items.title: Conversations that behave
items.description: Commit gates hold back hypotheses; a barge-in discards unplayed speech and stops the speaker.

items.title: Offline, egress denied
items.description: offline_strict refuses a remote model before anything opens; on Linux the egress watch fails the run on any other connection.

items.title: Usage per model call
items.description: One usage record per STT, LLM, TTS and native speech call; a count the provider leaves out stays unknown.

items.title: Session totals and pricing
items.description: Run and session usage totals, and cost records from a price document you supply.

items.title: Local text-to-speech
items.description: A local TTS adapter; the offline cascade speaks through a mock until then.

steps.label: stt · input gate
steps.title: Commit speech
steps.description: Committed spans pass; hypotheses are held back.

steps.label: output gate · tts
steps.title: Speak committed text
steps.description: A segment reaches TTS only once it is committed.

steps.label: speaker
steps.title: Play and confirm
steps.description: Only the speaker confirms playback; a barge-in drops what has not played.

sections.title: What exists today, and what is planned.
sections.lede: Every shipped item is in a release. Work on main for the next release is listed apart on the status page.

tools.name: llm
tools.description: inference's LLM contract wraps llm's model contract; the facade's cost feature prices usage with llm's cost crate.

tools.name: Secrets
tools.description: The OpenAI adapter's keychain feature reads the API key through Secrets.
